Transition release ends quarantine without dropping the Journey core package; explicit Journey leave, background hard teardown, Settings cleanup or pressure releases it. Captured Special jobs carry their exact working-set token through fetch/decode, so a stale old-family completion is discarded after replacement. A coherently prepared family gives both already-resident and newly decoded members one bounded cache-priority tier below repeatedly audible common cues and above once-audible stale cues, preventing sibling decode/evict thrash without increasing the ceiling. The first warning trims to the hottest bounded working set and a repeated warning releases all idle entries. Active/pending voices remain protected. Audible history counts successful native starts and evictions, survives eviction, and contains no AudioBuffer. Native onended owns ordinary one-shot retirement; one bounded authored-duration plus 250ms wall cleanup guard releases a non-loop record if a running WKWebView context has a frozen audio clock and never emits onended. Explicit stop, replacement, native completion and background cleanup cancel that guard; loops are excluded. Concurrent recovery callers share one native AudioContext.resume attempt instead of canceling and restarting it.
